corner.$description: Corner sizes. Ninefold rounds every corner softly (shape.round 1) and folds only its cards’ top-right corner (shape.card-cut).

shape.$description: How corner() draws a corner: the cut (a 45° chamfer) and the rounding, each a multiple of the corner size. Cards cut by card-cut instead.

round.$description: Ninefold: soft corners, rounded to their size

card-cut.$description: Ninefold: a card’s folded corner, 26px at rest (it lifts toward the pointer)

xs.$description: Only for tiny things: checkboxes, dots

full.$description: Status dots, wax drops and avatars
